# KB-MINTPY-003

- 엔진(engine): `mintpy`
- 단계(stage): `corrections`
- 심각도(severity): **FAIL**
- 패턴 검증(pattern_verified): **예** — 업스트림 소스 문자열에서 도출
- 패턴 출처(pattern_source): src/mintpy/tropo_pyaps3.py (dload_grib_files: 'WARNING: downloading failed for 3 times, stop trying and continue.'; check_pyaps_account_config: 'CDS account is NOT setup to the latest format! Check https://github.com/insarlab/PyAPS/.', 'PYAPS: No account info found for {tropo_model} in {section} section in file: {cfg_file}')

## 패턴 (regex)

```text
downloading failed for 3 times, stop trying and continue|CDS account is NOT setup to the latest format|PYAPS: No account info found for
```

## 원인 (Cause)

대기 지연 보정용 기상 재분석 자료(ERA5 등) 다운로드에 실패했습니다. PyAPS의 CDS(Copernicus Climate Data Store) 계정 설정이 없거나 구형 형식이거나, 네트워크 문제로 3회 재시도가 모두 실패한 경우입니다.

_EN_: Downloading the weather re-analysis data (e.g. ERA5) for tropospheric correction failed: the PyAPS CDS (Copernicus Climate Data Store) account is not configured or uses an outdated format, or all three download attempts failed for network reasons.

## 조치 (Fix)

PyAPS 안내(https://github.com/insarlab/PyAPS/)대로 CDS API 키를 최신 형식으로 등록하고 네트워크 접근을 확인한 뒤 재실행하세요. 미리 받은 자료가 있으면 mintpy.troposphericDelay.weatherDir 에 두면 다운로드를 건너뜁니다(wintersar fetch가 캐시합니다, PERF-02). 임시로는 mintpy.troposphericDelay.method 를 height_correlation 또는 gacos 로 바꿔 진행할 수 있습니다(wintersar 설정 timeseries.troposphere).

_EN_: Register the CDS API key in the current format as described by PyAPS (https://github.com/insarlab/PyAPS/), check network access and rerun. Pre-downloaded files placed in mintpy.troposphericDelay.weatherDir skip the download (wintersar fetch caches them, PERF-02). As a temporary workaround switch mintpy.troposphericDelay.method to height_correlation or gacos (wintersar config timeseries.troposphere).

## 자동 재시도 제안 (retry_hint)

```yaml
stage: corrections
action: retry
params:
  troposphere: height_correlation
note: Fallback reduces correction quality; restore era5 once the CDS account works.
```
